hacks.name: Keyboard Visualizer
hacks.description: Live piano-keyboard on Push's screen, from Live's actual sounding notes.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: Browser Bridge
hacks.description: Ableton Live MIDI Remote Script (PushHackBrowser) that loads .adv/.adg presets onto the selected track from push-manager's preset browser. Requires a one-time manual activation step in Live's Preferences.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: Automation
hacks.description: LFO-style MIDI CC automation sequencer. Draw curves in the web UI, send CC values to Push 3 in real-time so Live can record them as automation.
hacks.author: federico-pepe

hacks.name: Random Preset
hacks.description: Shift+Add loads a random preset, Shift+Swap a random drum rack kit.
hacks.author: itsrave
